description: AskAgento connects ChatGPT to WooCommerce stores that use the AskAgento plugin. Share a link to a store or one of its products and ask what you are looking for: AskAgento searches that store's catalogue semantically and returns matching products with prices, images, availability and links straight to the product pages. You can also ask about a specific product or find similar ones. Only stores whose owners have turned on ChatGPT listing are searchable. Checkout always happens on the store's own website.

defaultPrompt: Find me a watch on https://demowp.askagento.com
